notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.6.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added on-screen button prompts for Yin/Yang attack. This can be turned off in the Options menu.
[*] Updated Tutorial flow to better explain Reincarnation mechanics
[*] Fixed a bug with Soul Shard fusion calculation
[*] Fixed a bug where using Weapon Art while boss was on the ground breaks their hitbox
[*] Fixed a bug where mouse cursor popped up during Cinematic cutscene
[*] Tuned some attack hitboxes to better hit the player
[*] Fixed a bug where some bosses spawn Soul Limbo on death
[*] Fixed a bug where turrets permanently lose aggro when player goes outside range then return
[*] Changed Swim Up/Down controls to RB and LB
[*] Increased the speed of loot drop so player no longer have to wait for dead body to dissolve
[*] Fixed a bug where player could repeatedly trigger door opening animation
[*] Fixed a visual bug where character is stuck with an overlay VFX effect
[*] Implemented a possible fix for when the player suddenly unable to turn after attacking
[*] Implemented a possible fix for Confirmation box getting stuck on screen when unlocking new skill
[*] Slightly raised LockOn Camera to give a better view of the opponent
[*] Reduced the Woodsman’s fire glow
[*] Slightly longer Red/Blue/Yellow flash when enemies perform an unblockable attack
[*] Various other minor visual and UI bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.6.0
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Doubled the size of Annam with new bosses and minibosses[/p][/*][*][p]Added Bosh Rush system[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the entire progression system, now featuring a new Soul Shard fusion system[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the entire Skill Tree for each class and introduced Talents[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked every weapon to have more unique ability and move set[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Reincarnation system. Dying in the mortal realm will lose that Revenant form.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the checkpoint system. Checkpoint no longer respawns enemies or recharges heals. Replaced by the Soul Limbo mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other bug fixes and improvements
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New Miniboss: The Feathered Princess! The new boss replaced the old Archer boss
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing (A) in Title Menu does not work
[*] Player’s revival now starts at 50% max health
[*] Made adjustments to minibosses’ health and damage to make them more dangerous
[*] Reduced player’s base Stamina damage, but increases Parry damage for better risk/reward
[*] Other visual enhancements and minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9
notes.notes:
Summary of changes in this version:
[list]
[*] Revamped the entire progression system
[*] Implemented Reincarnation system as the new core game loop
[*] Introduced Skill Trees for each Revenant class
[*] Reworked the entire Capital map (improved Minibosses, new lighting and visuals)
[*] Improved all Weapon Arts to now deal elemental damages
[*] Improved various animations and SFX
[*] Various bug fixes and performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.8

[*] Visual improvements to 3 mini-bosses in the first level
[*] Other minor bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.7
notes.notes:
Summary of changes in this version:
[list]
[*] Added an Assist Mode that allows players to modify combat difficulty
[*] Updated the starting Weapon Arts for each Revenant class
[*] Major improvements to the 2nd Boss Fight
[*] Increased the base efficiency of healing and adjusted enemy's base damage
[*] Various other bug fixes and enhancements
[/list]
